units.egamma: keV in CSV; converted to MeV for Equation 5.6
units.intensity: relative to the 507.9/508 keV Band 1 transition

assumptions: Every reported ratio is explicitly conditional on delta=0 unless a scan value is stated.
Only same-initial-spin E2 and M1/E2 branches that can be paired without inventing a transition are analyzed.

Tables 4.1-4.7 report global intensities relative to 508 keV, whereas Section 5.3 says Figure 5.5 used spectra gated above each level. Table-based ratios are therefore diagnostic proxies, not reproductions of the published Figure 5.5 values.
Intensity uncertainties are propagated independently; gamma-energy uncertainties were not tabulated and are omitted.
The normalized Band 1 507.9 keV intensity is treated as exact for propagation, so that one uncertainty is underestimated.
Working parity is a user Figure 4.1-based provisional assignment cross-checked against Tables 4.1-4.7 and Chapter 5.
excluded_data: Absolute excitation energies not explicitly readable from the cited text are left blank rather than inferred from drawing position.
Transitions without a unique same-initial-state partner are not used in the table-intensity proxy calculation.
The unpublished gated branching intensities used for Figure 5.5 are not reconstructed or guessed.
The user's independent 131Ce experiment is a separate, unavailable dataset and is not represented here.
